Under the Entrez-date cutoff of 2020-11-22, the exposure block returned 115,041 records, the outcome block alone 3,839,121, and the combined search 15,792. The query uses an **Entrez entry-date** bound, not a publication-date limit. Counts use current PubMed indexing with that bound; they do not reconstruct the index as it existed in 2020.

Relative recall was 9/9 (100%) against the screened development set. There was no independent held-out validation set, and the nine records were found through a pilot using overlapping topic terms, so this is not independent validation or a sensitivity estimate. The tested outcome block cut retrieval by 86.3%, with no known-record loss and 0 relevant records among 30 sampled records it excluded; the remaining count still exceeds the standard 10,000-record workload budget.

The scope assumptions and limitations are recorded in [narrative.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-7e47969c4c7a654f/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T134709Z/work/narrative.md). This draft needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
